protocol.confidence: max(P(up), 1-P(up)); retain rows with confidence >= the stated threshold; P(up) >= 0.5 predicts UP
protocol.comparison: Evaluate candidate, original training-prior probability and always-UP direction on exactly the same candidate-selected rows
protocol.aggregation: Individual years and all years pooled by observation count, not equal-year mean
protocol.empty_selection: Coverage is zero; all conditional scores are null, never zero error or perfect accuracy
protocol.small_sample_policy: Flag fewer than 200 retained ticker-days or fewer than 20 distinct signal dates; heuristic disclosure, not a statistical validity threshold
protocol.selection_policy: Show every fixed threshold; do not select a winning threshold, tune, refit, or change serving behavior
protocol.holdout_policy: Read only the three completed development prediction exports; do not open price files or 2025 holdout files
limitations: Conditional samples differ across candidates and thresholds
Overlapping five-session outcomes and cross-stock dependence
No confidence intervals or significance guarantees in this descriptive audit
Confidence filtering is not evidence of profitable trading
